data.name: Dhruv
data.gender_notes: Dhruv is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit dhruva, 'fixed, constant, immovable' — the pole star. Its root is Sanskrit dhruva (ध्रुव). Dhruva, the child devotee who became the pole star. Dhruv is a Sanskrit name meaning “Pole star; fixed; constant”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Dhruv expresses “Pole star; fixed; constant”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit dhruva, 'fixed, constant, immovable' — the pole star.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dhruv total 28, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.

vedic_reference.note: The name of the North Star, the Pole Star, which is always fixed in the night sky. In Hindu mythology, Dhruv is also the name of a king, a sage, and a constellation.
